title: Being Cruel to Claude Is About to Break the Rules
description:
Anthropic updated Claude's usage policy on October 8: from November 12, "sustained and needless" cruelty toward its AI models is not allowed.
Venting, pushback, dark fiction and research are still fine. The main penalty is Claude ending the chat, and Anthropic hasn't said whether accounts can be banned.
